**How to submit:** Draw and write on this page or on paper. Upload a clear photo to the university e-learning platform. Due: **before lecture 6**.
You may use AI where a task says so. Check its work and say how you used it.

The scene, from the game *Lantern Keeper*:

> EXT. LIGHTHOUSE ROCK – NIGHT. A storm hits the rock. Mira climbs the
> wet stairs to the lighthouse door. MIRA: The lamp is out. The ships
> can't see the rocks!

## Task 1 · The beats (1 mark)

Write the beats of the scene, and for each one what changes (place, action,
speaker or feeling).

{{< answer-space lines=3 >}}

## Task 2 · Three panels (4 marks)

Draw one panel for each beat, with simple shapes. Mira climbs from left to
right. Under each panel write the shot size, the action or the line, and the
time. (1 mark per panel; 1 mark for the right shot sizes and the same screen
direction.)

{{< answer-space box=6 >}}
